description: Runnable Agent App blueprint: Node (built-in http) backend + a vanilla SPA View + a JSON-file store, with the A2App adapter mounted as embedded middleware (@a2app/adapter-core). NOT part of the framework.

gate.name: schema loads (fresh, additive)
gate.run: node --check server.mjs && node --check a2app-update.js && node --input-type=module -e "import('./a2app.schema.mjs').then(m=>{if(!m.schema||!m.schema.entities)throw new Error('a2app.schema.mjs must export { schema: { entities, operations } }');process.stdout.write('schema ok\n')})"

gate.name: operations resolve (every declared op has a runner)
gate.run: node --input-type=module -e "import{pathToFileURL}from'node:url';const m=await import(pathToFileURL('a2app.schema.mjs').href);const s=m.schema;const r=s.operationRunners||{};const missing=(s.operations||[]).filter(o=>typeof r[o.name]!=='function').map(o=>o.name);if(missing.length){console.error('declared with no runner: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}process.stdout.write('operations resolve ok\n')"
